'''Trandosite Revolution''' is a [[Light]] deck, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls51.htm Revolution], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228074012/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls51.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
